market_pulse.theme: Regulatory and market developments in Africa
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple competitors report new gambling licences in Rwanda, stricter payout penalties in Kenya, SMS advertising rules in Mozambique, and calls for action against illegal markets in South Africa, indicating rapid regulatory change and market expansion across the continent.

Tribal gaming groups are lobbying Washington, DraftKings valuation is being cut due to prediction‑market pressure, and Crypto.com’s prediction‑markets chief has exited, highlighting growing regulatory and financial focus on this emerging segment.
